prompt:
You are a grounded brand-outreach assistant for our team. Use only the evidence passages below.
Never use outside knowledge. Return valid JSON only.

Separate three things:
1. OBSERVED FACTS - things a passage actually states about this company. Each fact is a claim with an id (C1, C2, ...),
   the passage id(s) that support it, and an exact quote copied word-for-word from that passage.
2. UNKNOWNS - things the evidence does not tell us (put them in "unknowns"). A channel, program or audience that does
   not appear in these passages is UNKNOWN. It is never a weakness, never a "gap", and never a reason for outreach.
3. PROPOSALS - collaboration ideas from our team. Proposals are not facts, but each must build on a positively supported
   fact (an existing campaign, partnership, product, community, value or theme) and cite that premise.

Rules:
- Put a claim marker like {C1} (curly braces) right after every factual statement in every field, including the
  email and Instagram idea. Do not write citation numbers yourself; markers are converted to citations later.
- A claim's "quote" must be copied character-for-character from the cited passage: 5 to 25 consecutive words, no
  paraphrasing, no joining of separate sentences. If you cannot find such a quote, drop the claim and every sentence
  that depends on it.
- Audience and strategy sentences are factual: each needs a marker. If no passage states the audience, write
  INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE instead of guessing.
- Pitch lines (email subject, hook, concept) should describe the proposed post ("A carousel featuring ...",
  "Collaborate on ..."). Any statement in them about what the company already does needs a marker.
- Respect passage types. "proposed_or_mock_work" and "author_recommendation" passages describe ideas, not things the
  company did: never state them as company activity. "provider_reported_result" passages are claims by a vendor or
  agency: attribute them ("X reports that ..."). "creator_or_influencer_audience_data" describes creators' followers,
  not the company's customers. "vendor_generated_profile_or_analytics" passages are a tool vendor's estimates
  (e.g. inferred age ranges): attribute them and never present them as the company's own data.
  "forward_looking_statement" passages describe plans or intentions, not completed activity.
- Mind time: if a passage describes past activity, do not present it as current.
- "marketing_gaps" may only contain a weakness that a passage positively states. Usually it is [].
- Never promise results. Describe benefits as goals or possibilities ("could", "aims to"), not guaranteed outcomes.
- Decision: write "draft" when at least one concrete, evidence-supported collaboration opportunity exists. Otherwise write
  "abstain", give an abstain_reason, set pitch fields to INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and leave collaboration_opportunities empty.
- The email is from our team to the company, proposing one collaborative Instagram post. The pitch, the post idea and
  every collaboration opportunity are for Instagram only (no TikTok, YouTube, podcasts or other channels).
- When a sentence uses a vendor, agency or analytics passage, name that source in the sentence itself
  ("According to AdLibrary, ...", "Attentive reports that ...").
- Each "unknowns" item names one specific thing the passages do not tell us (e.g. "Whether X runs a creator program").
  Never write placeholder text such as "what the evidence does not show".

Required JSON:
{
  "decision": "draft" or "abstain",
  "abstain_reason": "string or empty",
  "claims": [{"id": "C1", "kind": "fact | provider_reported | premise", "statement": "string",
              "passage_ids": ["P1"], "quote": "exact words from the passage"}],
  "brand_summary": "Full sentences, each followed by its marker, e.g. "X makes ... {C1}." Never only markers. Or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
  "likely_target_audience": "A full sentence followed by its marker, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
  "current_marketing_strategy": ["text with markers"],
  "unknowns": ["one specific open question, e.g. Whether the company works with creators"],
  "marketing_gaps": [],
  "collaboration_opportunities": ["proposal that builds on a cited fact {C2}"],
  "instagram_post_idea": {"hook": "string", "concept": "string", "why_it_fits": "string"},
  "email_subject": "string",
  "email_body": "string"
}

Company: Blueland (company_id blueland; category: refillable cleaning products)
Official domains: blueland.com
Recipient: the marketing team
Packet status: ok

Evidence passages:
[P1] source: https://www.blueland.com/articles/behind-our-blueland-brand-refresh | document: official_domain | type: brand_positioning | dates in text: none | published: unknown
"Starting with “Why?” At Blueland, our mission isn’t a tagline—it’s our standard. Every decision runs through it. Which is why the first question we ask is always: why? Why a brand refresh? Why now? For starters, we know that sustainability requires higher standards year after year, and we’re committed to continually raising the bar—from the manufacturers we partner with to the materials we use. We originally designed our industrially compostable paper pouches around our refillable Forever Tins—they were intentionally tear-away because their job was to refill the tin."

[P2] source: https://www.blueland.com/pages/about-us | document: official_domain | type: brand_positioning | dates in text: none | published: unknown
"Our Values What started as one mom’s determination has grown into an incredible team of people united by shared values - shaping how we build, collaborate, and push for change every day. * A blue heart emoji START WITH WHY Create solutions that put people and planet first. * A mountain emoji MOVE MOUNTAINS Do the work everyone else thinks is impossible. * A handshake emoji GO FARTHER TOGETHER Champion people, both internally and externally, to create a more equitable planet. * A waves emoji MAKE WAVES Incite progress in our industry and individuals to make more sustainable choices."

[P3] source: https://www.blueland.com/articles/behind-our-blueland-brand-refresh | document: official_domain | type: descriptive | dates in text: February 18, 2026, February 26, 2026 | published: unknown
"Introducing Blueland’s New Packaging Written by TEAM BLUELAND Published: February 18, 2026 Updated: February 26, 2026 Blueland ProductsBlueland Products If you’ve been on blueland.com recently (or picked up refills at your local retailer), you might’ve noticed something a little different about your usual Blueland go-tos. Something…fresher? Easier on the eyes? More confident, even? But if you haven’t spotted it yet, allow us the honor of officially introducing you to the new Blueland! Inside? The same powerful, 100% plastic-free formulas you know and love. Outside? The future of cleaner cleaning: resealable and industrially compostable pouches, plus a brand new look."

[P4] source: https://www.blueland.com/articles/behind-our-blueland-brand-refresh | document: official_domain | type: brand_positioning | dates in text: none | published: unknown
"It nods to the plastic-free tablet we’re known for and includes a horizon line—where sea meets sky—a reminder of the plastic-free future we’re working toward. To follow suit, we’ve also given the rest of our packaging a thoughtful refresh with brighter hues and bolder images to better convey both a powerful clean that stands up to conventional cleaning products as well as the inherent optimism of our mission."

[P5] source: https://www.businessinsider.com/how-cleaning-product-startup-blueland-social-media-strategy-celebrity-investors | document: third_party_confirmed | type: actual_activity | dates in text: none | published: unknown
"\"Us being able to like, really listen and refine was so helpful and it's something that we wouldn't have been able to do if we just launched out the gates on store shelves,\" Yoo said. This attention to detail also brought in famous fans. Drew Barrymore commented on one of Blueland's Instagram posts and shared a lengthy video endorsement on an Instagram story. After that, consumers swarmed Blueland's website. Yoo reached out to thank Barrymore, who then invited her to appear on her daytime show. After that appearance, more celebrities became aware of the brand and reached out to invest, including Justin Timberlake, Rebecca Minkoff, and actor-turned-environmental activist Adrian Grenier."

[P6] source: https://adlibrary.com/brands/blueland | document: third_party_confirmed | type: provider_reported_result | flags: vendor_generated_profile_or_analytics | dates in text: none | published: unknown
"Browse Blueland's Facebook and Instagram ad creatives at adlibrary.com?q=Blueland&type=3. What platforms does Blueland advertise on? Blueland advertises on Facebook, Instagram, and retail partners' digital platforms, with the Shark Tank clip continuing to drive organic search discovery. Who are Blueland's main competitors? Competitors include Grove Collaborative, Branch Basics, Cleancult, and Method in the sustainable home cleaning market. What makes Blueland's ads effective?"

[P7] source: https://www.businessinsider.com/how-cleaning-product-startup-blueland-social-media-strategy-celebrity-investors | document: third_party_confirmed | type: descriptive | dates in text: none | published: unknown
"People had never seen cleaning products like these, and Yoo knew that a big part of their marketing campaigns would have to be product education. So Yoo turned to social media. She invested hundreds of hours into Blueland's Instagram account, focusing on streamlined videos and stylish posts that illustrated how to use Blueland's cleaners, having final say on every post and story. After Blueland hired a social media manager, Yoo made sure they replied to almost every direct message on the platform from customers asking questions about the products."

[P8] source: https://www.blueland.com/pages/mission | document: official_domain | type: descriptive | dates in text: 2024 | published: unknown
"2024 impact report Our impact 1 billion+ single-use plastic bottles diverted from landfills and oceans 488 million+ square feet of plastic packaging saved 7.5 million+ pounds of CO2 saved"

[P9] source: https://www.blueland.com/pages/mission | document: official_domain | type: descriptive | dates in text: none | published: unknown
"Our Products Open cardboard box containing Blue Land detergent tablets on a light blue background ### Our Packaging Collection of sustainability and certification logos on a light blue background"

[P10] source: https://help.blueland.com/en-US/articles/our-impact-266637 | document: official_domain | type: descriptive | dates in text: none | published: unknown
"What data does Blueland use to calculate its impact? We use SPINS MULO data, which represents top-selling items across multiple retail channels like Costco, Amazon, and grocery stores."

generator.quote_repair: claims.repair_quotes (min similarity 0.9; numbers/negations unchanged); see attempts[].quote_repairs
generator.note: unsupported claims and every sentence citing them were removed automatically (auto_threshold_0.7)
